LanguageData.CC_Settings_RoleClothesReach: Role clothes the colony can reach
LanguageData.CC_Settings_RoleClothesReach_Tip: When the game chooses the clothes an ideoligion's roles ask for (a new ideoligion, a reform, a role added, Randomize in a role's editor), its first pick for the colony's own ideoligions leaves out clothes the colony can't reach: the colony has none, and every way to make them needs research that isn't finished, is off the usual path (a mod's own research tab, or a project meant for a special start such as Vanilla Factions Expanded - Classical's) and costs at least half again what a project of its age usually costs. That mod's toga, 1200 research for a neolithic project, is the case that asked for this. Clothes the ideoligion calls for stay (a meme or a desired apparel asks for them, or its culture, a meme or a style comes from the same mod), and when nothing else fits the game picks from everything as before. The factions' own ideoligions are left as the game makes them. Clothes a role already asks for don't change: "Choose other clothes for the role" on the Mood tab does that when you want it. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_RoleClothesReach: New roles of your ideoligions don't ask for clothes behind costly research off the usual path.
